itinerary.title: Arrive, Unwind, Explore
itinerary.description:
Your Bali adventure begins the moment you land. Our representative warmly greets you at Ngurah Rai International Airport (Denpasar) and transfers you directly to your hotel — everything is seamlessly taken care of.

The rest of the day is completely yours:
• Relax by the resort pool after your flight
• Stroll through vibrant local streets and boutique shops
• Soak in the enchanting Balinese atmosphere at your own leisurely pace.

itinerary.title: Kintamani Volcano Tour — Dance, Temples, Coffee, Rice Terraces & Ubud
itinerary.description:
Highlands and Volcano:
Begin your day traveling into Bali’s picturesque central highlands. Stop at an authentic local plantation to sample world-famous Luwak coffee and exotic spiced teas. Next, ascend to Kintamani to take in dramatic panoramic views of active Mount Batur volcano and its crater lake over lunch.

Terraces and Ubud:
Walk among the iconic sculpted emerald curves of Tegalalang rice terraces. Continue into the cultural heart of Bali to explore Ubud's historical Royal Palace (Puri Saren Agung), traditional artist craft villages (woodcarving and silver smithing), and the bustling Ubud Art Market.

itinerary.title: Temples, Lakes, and the Sea
itinerary.description:
A day dedicated to Bali's most iconic spiritual landmarks and breathtaking natural landscapes.

Your route through the island's sacred sites:
• Pura Taman Ayun — Grand 17th-century royal family temple surrounded by wide moats, soaring tiered meru shrines, and manicured gardens
• Ulun Danu Bratan — The world-renowned floating temple resting on Lake Beratan, framed by cool misty mountain peaks
• Lunch at Pacung — Savor delicious local flavors with sweeping elevated views over lush terraced rice fields
• Tanah Lot — Bali's iconic sea temple perched on a rocky ocean outcrop, surrounded by crashing waves during the golden afternoon.

itinerary.title: Flight from Bali to Malaysia
itinerary.description:
After breakfast at your resort, complete hotel check-out and meet your driver for a private transfer to the airport.

Board your international flight from Bali across the Java Sea to Malaysia (Kuala Lumpur). Upon landing at Kuala Lumpur International Airport (KLIA), our local Malaysian desk greets you and escorts you to your city hotel.

Check in, unwind, and carry home the warmth of Bali while looking forward to Malaysia’s modern metropolis and cultural delights.

itinerary.title: Genting Highlands, Batu Caves & Kuala Lumpur City Tour
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a full-day adventure combining nature, spirituality, and mountain entertainment.

Tour Highlights Include:
• Visit to Batu Caves — Climb the 272 vibrant rainbow stairs past the monumental 140-foot golden Lord Murugan statue into limestone cavern temples
• Scenic Mountain Drive — Ascend through lush tropical rainforest hills towards Genting Highlands
• Skyway Cable Car Ride — Soar above ancient mist-covered rainforest canopy with breathtaking 360-degree panoramic views
• Genting Mountain Resort — Explore the premier entertainment resort, indoor theme complexes, and shopping arcades before descending to Kuala Lumpur.

itinerary.title: Kuala Lumpur Comprehensive City Tour
itinerary.description:
Explore the dynamic capital city of Kuala Lumpur, where futuristic skyscrapers blend harmoniously with rich colonial and Islamic architectural heritage.

City Tour Highlights:
• Petronas Twin Towers — Iconic photo stop at the base of the world's tallest twin towers (451.9m)
• Istana Negara (King’s Palace) — Grand royal residence with regal brass gates and traditional guards
• National Mosque (Masjid Negara) & Independence Square (Dataran Merdeka) with the historic Sultan Abdul Samad Building
• Beryl’s Chocolate Kingdom & Local Handicraft Center — Sample artisanal Malaysian chocolates and shop for authentic batik crafts
• Leisure and shopping time at Bukit Bintang or Suria KLCC shopping districts.

Enjoy a relaxed breakfast at your hotel. Complete hotel check-out.

Meet your driver for a private transfer to Kuala Lumpur International Airport (KLIA). Board your return flight to Kathmandu with unforgettable memories of Bali’s spiritual and cultural beauty and Malaysia’s vibrant city experiences.

Afterwards, visit the world-famous Batu Caves—a 400-million-year-old sacred limestone Hindu temple complex located on the outskirts of Kuala Lumpur. Make a quick photo stop at the Gate of the Kingʼs Palace (Istana Negara) to admire the royal guards and regal architecture. itinerary.title: Halong Bay Overnight Luxury Cruise Experience
itinerary.highlight: Tuan Chau Harbour • Halong Bay UNESCO Wonder • Surprise Cave • Titov Island • Vietnamese Cooking Class
itinerary.description:
08:00 AM — Hotel Check-out & Scenic Transfer:
Enjoy breakfast at the hotel, check out, and board your comfortable transfer journey through the lush Red River Delta countryside toward Halong Bay.

12:30 PM — Arrival at Tuan Chau International Harbour:
The cruise reception team welcomes guests at the private harbour lounge.

12:45 PM — Cruise Boarding by Tender:
Board your luxury cruise ship by tender boat. Be greeted with a refreshing welcome drink, receive a cruise safety briefing, and check into your private sea-view cabin.

01:00 PM — Begin Halong Bay Cruise & Gourmet Lunch:
Depart Tuan Chau Harbour into the heart of Halong Bay, designated as one of the New 7 Wonders of Nature. Savor a delectable lunch featuring fresh seafood and Vietnamese specialties while gliding past legendary karst formations, including Ba Hang Fishing Village, Dinh Huong Island (Incense Burner), Cho Da Islet (Stone Dog), and Ga Choi Islet (Fighting Cocks).

02:30 PM — Surprise Cave (Hang Sung Sot):
Transfer by tender to Surprise Cave, widely hailed as the largest and most magnificent cavern in Halong Bay, filled with awe-inspiring illuminated stalactites and stalagmites sculpted over millions of years.

03:45 PM — Titov Island Beach & Panoramic Viewpoint:
Visit Titov Island, famously named after Soviet cosmonaut Gherman Titov. Relax and swim on the crescent white-sand beach, or climb the 400 stone steps to the summit for an unforgettable 360-degree panoramic vista over Halong Bay's emerald waters.

04:45 PM — Sunset on the Sundeck:
Return to the cruise. Relax with a chilled drink on the sundeck as the ship navigates to its tranquil overnight anchorage amidst the towering limestone islands.

06:00 PM – 07:00 PM — Happy Hour:
Enjoy Happy Hour drink specials on the sundeck (Buy 1 Get 1 Free on select drinks, wine excluded).

06:30 PM — Vietnamese Cooking Demonstration:
Participate in an interactive culinary demonstration where the onboard chef teaches the art of rolling traditional Vietnamese fresh spring rolls.

07:00 PM — Set-Menu Dinner:
Indulge in a lavish Vietnamese set-menu dinner in the elegant panoramic dining room.

08:30 PM — Evening Activities & Stargazing:
Join fun evening activities including night squid fishing from the tender platform, film entertainment in the lounge, or soothing spa/massage treatments (massage at additional charge). Overnight stay onboard the Halong Bay cruise.

itinerary.title: Return from Cruise and Half-Day Hanoi City Tour

itinerary.description:
06:30 AM — Tai Chi on the Sundeck:
Greet the morning with a refreshing 30-minute Tai Chi masterclass on the sundeck as golden sunlight filters through the limestone peaks while cruising toward Luon Cave.

07:00 AM — Light Breakfast:
Enjoy fresh coffee, tea, pastries, toast, eggs, fresh tropical fruit, and cereals in the dining room.

08:00 AM — Luon Cave Exploration by Traditional Bamboo Boat:
Board a traditional woven bamboo boat rowed gently by a local boatman. Glide beneath the low limestone arch of Luon Cave into a secluded emerald lagoon enclosed by sheer vertical cliffs, home to wild golden monkeys.

08:30 AM — Return & Cabin Check-out:
Return to the cruise, freshen up, and complete cabin check-out. Porters will collect your luggage outside your cabin door.

09:15 AM — Buffet Brunch:
Relish a bountiful buffet brunch in the dining room as the ship cruises gently back toward the mainland. Settle any personal onboard beverage bills.

10:45 AM — Disembarkation & Transfer to Hanoi:
Transfer by tender to Tuan Chau Harbour and disembark. Meet your transfer representative and vehicle to proceed comfortably back to Hanoi hotel.

Afternoon — Half-Day Hanoi City Tour:
Join your expert English-speaking tour guide for an engaging cultural exploration of Hanoi:
• Ho Chi Minh Complex: Visit the dignified Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, walk across expansive Ba Dinh Square (where Vietnamese independence was proclaimed), and admire the historic 11th-century One Pillar Pagoda rising like a lotus flower from a tranquil pond.
• Temple of Literature (Van Mieu): Explore Vietnam's very first national university, founded in 1070, featuring peaceful courtyards, ancient stone turtle steles, and classical Confucian architecture.
• Hoan Kiem Lake & Old Quarter: Discover the mythical heart of Hanoi at Hoan Kiem Lake (Lake of the Restored Sword) featuring the historic Turtle Tower. Stroll among the French colonial facades and enjoy free time exploring the lively streets of the 36 Guilds Hanoi Old Quarter.

Overnight stay in Hanoi.

itinerary.title: Comprehensive Hanoi City Tour & Train Street
itinerary.highlight: Tran Quoc Pagoda • Ho Chi Minh Complex • One Pillar Pagoda • Temple of Literature • Hanoi Train Street
itinerary.description:
Between 08:00 AM and 08:30 AM, meet your friendly local English-speaking tour guide at the hotel lobby and set out for an enriching full-day guided exploration of Hanoi's most iconic historical landmarks:

1. Tran Quoc Pagoda:
Begin at Tran Quoc Pagoda, gracefully located on Golden Fish Island in scenic West Lake. Established in the 6th century during the reign of King Ly Nam De, it is Hanoi's oldest and most sacred Buddhist pagoda.

2. Ho Chi Minh Complex:
Visit the revered Ho Chi Minh Complex, where you will have the opportunity to view President Ho Chi Minh's embalmed resting place in the solemn mausoleum. Walk through the tranquil presidential botanical gardens and see the preserved stilt house and Mango Alley where Uncle Ho lived and worked from 1954 to 1969.

3. One Pillar Pagoda:
Marvel at the unique One Pillar Pagoda (Chua Mot Cot), an extraordinary 11th-century architectural lotus-inspired monument dedicated to the Buddhist Goddess of Mercy (Quan Am).

4. Temple of Literature (Van Mieu):
Explore Vietnam's first national university, established in 1070 under Emperor Ly Thanh Tong. Admire the historic stone stelae atop carved tortoise shells honoring ancient doctorates, tranquil courtyards, and ancient scholarly pavilions.

5. Hanoi Train Street:
Conclude your sightseeing along the world-famous Hanoi Train Street, where everyday Vietnamese neighborhood life unfolds merely inches beside the active railway tracks. Sip a cool drink at a tracks-side cafe as you soak in this unforgettable urban spectacle.

Important Notes: Modest attire covering shoulders and knees is strictly required at temples, pagodas, and the Ho Chi Minh Complex. The Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum is closed on Mondays and Fridays, and closes for annual maintenance from 15 June to 15 August (photo stops and garden exploration remain open). Overnight stay in Hanoi.

itinerary.title: Comprehensive Hanoi City Tour & Train Street
itinerary.highlight: Tran Quoc Pagoda • Ho Chi Minh Complex • One Pillar Pagoda • Temple of Literature • Hanoi Train Street
itinerary.description:
Between 08:00 AM and 08:30 AM, meet your friendly local English-speaking tour guide at the hotel lobby and set out for an enriching full-day guided exploration of Hanoi's most iconic historical landmarks:

1. Tran Quoc Pagoda:
Begin at Tran Quoc Pagoda, gracefully located on Golden Fish Island in scenic West Lake. Established in the 6th century during the reign of King Ly Nam De, it is Hanoi's oldest and most sacred Buddhist pagoda.

2. Ho Chi Minh Complex:
Visit the revered Ho Chi Minh Complex, where you will have the opportunity to view President Ho Chi Minh's embalmed resting place in the solemn mausoleum. Walk through the tranquil presidential botanical gardens and see the preserved stilt house and Mango Alley where Uncle Ho lived and worked from 1954 to 1969.

3. One Pillar Pagoda:
Marvel at the unique One Pillar Pagoda (Chua Mot Cot), an extraordinary 11th-century architectural lotus-inspired monument dedicated to the Buddhist Goddess of Mercy (Quan Am).

4. Temple of Literature (Van Mieu):
Explore Vietnam's first national university, established in 1070 under Emperor Ly Thanh Tong. Admire the historic stone stelae atop carved tortoise shells honoring ancient doctorates, tranquil courtyards, and ancient scholarly pavilions.

5. Hanoi Train Street:
Conclude your sightseeing along the world-famous Hanoi Train Street, where everyday Vietnamese neighborhood life unfolds merely inches beside the active railway tracks. Sip a cool drink at a tracks-side cafe as you soak in this unforgettable urban spectacle.

Important Notes: Modest attire covering shoulders and knees is strictly required at temples, pagodas, and the Ho Chi Minh Complex. The Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum is closed on Mondays and Fridays, and closes for annual maintenance from 15 June to 15 August (photo stops and garden exploration remain open). Overnight stay in Hanoi.
